entries.text: Archiv 415 514-2 — February 1985, All Saints, Tooting; Monteverdi Choir and English Baroque Soloists; street 15 November 1985; NBA Smend — is Gardiner’s first B-minor Mass, not SDG-722 (2015), not the 2013 RAH live, and not later filmed concerts. Mixed choir of roughly two dozen with concertino/ripieno contrasts — deliberately not Rifkin OVPP; Gramophone later recorded Gardiner rejecting OVPP for this work when promoting the remake. Lindsay Kemp’s Gramophone feature on SDG-722 treats the 1985 set as having acquired benchmark status, the disc found on shelves. Awards for the remake do not travel backwards. Référence among the assessed Mass cards: the mid-1980s Archiv HIP studio document that later readings still argue with.
